name: US core prices
qualification_basis: Explicit NYSE Group scheduled holidays and early closes, updated for the Carter closure independently announced by NYSE and Nasdaq; literal annual counts and UTC conversions checked. Qualification concerns the documented core-session schedule, not provider aggregation, point-in-time availability, or an independent runtime calendar oracle. Raw official-document bytes and checksums have not been retained.

sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2020, 2021 and 2022 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
sources.evidence_role: Scheduled weekday closures and 13:00 Eastern early closes for 2020 and 2021. The later Juneteenth amendment governs 2022.

sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2022, 2023 and 2024 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
sources.evidence_role: Scheduled closures and early closes for 2022 and 2023, including Juneteenth beginning in 2022 and no observed New Year closure for Saturday 2022-01-01.

sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2024, 2025 and 2026 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
sources.evidence_role: Scheduled closures and early closes for 2024 and 2025. The subsequently announced Carter closure supplements this planned calendar.

sources.title: The New York Stock Exchange Will Close Markets on January 9 to Honor the Passing of Former President Jimmy Carter on National Day of Mourning
sources.evidence_role: Additional full-day closure on 2025-01-09 for all NYSE Group equity markets, including NYSE Arca.

sources.title: U.S. Markets will be Closed for a National Day of Mourning for Former President Jimmy Carter
sources.evidence_role: Independent Nasdaq confirmation of the 2025-01-09 equities closure. URL identifier ETA2024-87; displayed heading Equity Trader Alert #2024-86.

sources.title: Holidays and Trading Hours
sources.evidence_role: Core equities session 09:30 to 16:00 Eastern. Current page holiday years roll forward; historical dates come from the archived releases. Publication date is not established.

supplemental_closures.reason: National Day of Mourning for former President Jimmy Carter
